// Fixed types for task (i). Do not edit; check.sh uses its own copy.
import type { ListenerError, ReadonlyStore } from "@get-modular/observation";

/** The notifications module's own slice of the settings. Quiet hours are written as "<from>-<to>", for example "22-7". */
export type NotificationSettings = { readonly quietHours: string };
export type QuietHours = { readonly from: number; readonly to: number };
/** Throws a RangeError for text that is not "<from>-<to>" with hours from 0 to 23. */
export declare function parseQuietHours(text: string): QuietHours;

/** An existing adapter. */
export type Notifier = {
  readonly setQuietHours: (hours: QuietHours) => void;
  readonly quietHours: () => QuietHours;
};
export declare function createNotifier(hours: QuietHours): Notifier;

/** What the module publishes to other modules. */
export type NotificationStatus = { readonly muted: boolean };
/** The Host's error sink. */
export type ErrorsPort = { readonly report: (report: ListenerError) => undefined };
export type NotificationsDeps = { readonly settings: ReadonlyStore<NotificationSettings>; readonly errors: ErrorsPort };
export type NotificationsPort = { readonly mute: (muted: boolean) => undefined };

export type NotificationsProduct = {
  readonly instance: Notifier;
  readonly capabilities: {
    readonly "acme/notifications": NotificationsPort;
    readonly "acme/notifications/status": ReadonlyStore<NotificationStatus>;
  };
};
